prompt: In which year did Anil Biswas (an Indian communist politician) join the Krishnagar Government College, come under the influence of Marxist leaders like Harinarayan Adhikari and Dinesh Mazumdar, and also become an active member of the Students' Federation of India?
answer: Anil Biswas joined Krishnagar Government College in **1961**. During that time, he came under the influence of Marxist leaders Harinarayan Adhikari and Dinesh Mazumdar and became active in the Students’ Federation of India.
